The '''Type IV Ship Restraining Net''' was a [[conner web]], an updated version of the [[conner net]], manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The Type IV could be deployed against targets in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="PP" />
